entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • DBSC: support site scope registration from subdomains #67827
  • Built-in OpenAPI generator emits 3.0-era `format: binary` for binary/file types in 3.1/3.2 documents #67826
  • CsrfProtectionMiddleware introduced in .NET 11 Preview 6 does not considers the QUERY method #67825
  • JsonPatch: `ParsedPath` drops empty JSON Pointer tokens (RFC 6901) #67819
  • Harden KnownProxies/KnownNetworks for non-IP transports #67816
  • Design proposal: Add FieldIdentifier support to EditContext validation notifications #67815
  • Blazor Gateway dev-server gaps for runtime/WBT #67814
  • Fix scheme-relative behavior in Rewrite middleware #67812
  • Design for SSR Constructor Enhancements #67808
  • Design for Virtualize SSR Initial Item Rendering #67807
  • Analyzer: warn when SslCertificateTrust is set without a RemoteCertificateValidationCallback #67806

Closed

  • ASPNETCORE SCOPE #67824
  • template build consensus #67823
  • Add seekable stream support to InputFile #67779
  • Design proposal to support binding data from a GET-based form #67804
  • API Proposal: QuickGrid static SSR support #66830
    11.0-preview6
  • aspnetcoretools.so: use source control version string format. #67637
  • new issueTmp #67803
  • Failed to log in with passkey for Blazor Web Individual app after installing .NET 11.0 preview 5 SDK #66732
    11.0-preview6

    community-contribution

    community-contribution

Merged

    tell-mode, community-contribution
